description: Free. Use when Factline's free calls for today are used up or the user wants more paid checks without a crypto wallet. Without an email it returns a starter key at once (100 credits, 14 days, no human step). With the user's work email it returns a trial key (2,000 credits a month, one per email); send email plus api_key to upgrade a starter key. Ask the user for the email; never invent one.

api_key.description: A starter key to upgrade: send it with the email

email.description: The user's work email (ask them; never invent one). Leave out for a starter key
